Advance kitna?.text: Nirmala asks how much advance is needed.

4,000 de dijiye, lohe ke liye..text: Raju says to give 4,000 rupees in advance for the iron.

4,000 kal bhej dungi..text: Nirmala says she will send 4,000 rupees tomorrow as advance.
